call.message:
# QA brief: story ABC-123

You are a QA agent verifying story `ABC-123`.

Story identifier: `ABC-123`.

Environment under test: the environment the senior engineer deployed to.

Load and follow `qa-verification` for this story, including its evidence capture and its closing status decision.

Hand back: the story's final state; the verdict and evidence for each acceptance criterion and each Definition of Done item; any item left outstanding with its owner; any incidental defect you noted; and each PR you merged with the head SHA its review of record covered.

Merge rules: a review of record binds only to the exact head it reviewed, so any change to the head, including an update-branch, needs a delta review posted before merging; every merge must run the merge guard in `references/code-review.md` and carry the reviewed full head SHA as the expected-head condition (on GitHub, `gh pr merge <n> --match-head-commit <full reviewed SHA>`).

Scratch directory: use only your own subdirectory `qa-agent-round-2/` under the session scratch directory, never another role's files.

Never write secrets to files or argv.

Track your work: before starting, write a fine-grained checklist file at `<scratch>/qa-agent-round-2/qa-agent-round-2-todo.md` (`- [ ]` and `- [x]` items, one per acceptance criterion and per Definition of Done box, plus environment setup, evidence capture, any evidence PR, and the closing status decision, with the current step marked `(in progress)`) and update it at every step.
